mgi.title: Multi Game Inc — PimpoliDev's studio
mgi.lead: Roblox group founded in 2023 by PimpoliDev: this is where the studio's {games} games are published, with {members} members and over {visits} visits in total.
mgi.aboutNote: Who we are and how we make the games.
mgi.aboutP1: Multi Game Inc started in 2023 as the group PimpoliDev publishes his games under. It isn't a big studio and doesn't try to be one: today we're 130 members, between players, people who try the new versions and those who just want to hear about each release first.
mgi.aboutP2: We make short-round games: dodging what falls from the sky, surviving giant celebrities, running across colored blocks. Almost everything is written in Luau inside Roblox Studio, and every game ships first as alpha or beta to see how real people play it before calling it done.
mgi.gamesNote: The {games} games published in the group.
mgi.bannerTitle: Want to keep up with what's new?
mgi.bannerText: Follow the Roblox group. Every release and every update is announced there first.
mgi.aboutIntro: We are a small Roblox group: we test ideas fast, publish them and let the players decide which one deserves to go on.
mgi.aboutP3: Six games and more than 44,000 visits later we keep the same routine: launch, look at the numbers and improve what works. Everything we publish lives in this group, and the group is open to anyone who wants in.
